run_generate_adt: run the generate_adt script to download ADT query points and compute remaining annotations
build_generate_adt_npz: build the generate_adt_npz function to generate final ADT npz files with remaining annotations
run_main_entry: run the main entry point to download ADT npz files from GCS and process them
test_generate_adt_npz: test the generate_adt_npz function with adt_base_path, input_npz_dir, and output_npz_dir arguments
review_main: review the main function that downloads ADT files from GCS and computes remaining annotations
